title: Settings not synced between elevated and non-levated runs; configs reset after restart / update

judgment.rationale: The sequence is actionable, but the exact configuration paths and timing of the reset are needed before selecting a safe shared-settings change.
evidence: Multiple modules are named as affected.
A fresh report ZIP was attached in follow-up activity.
Related #47238 is open but covers a different administrator-startup symptom.
judgment.recommended_action: Request paired config-path/timestamp evidence and distinguish same-version restart from update migration.

fix_assessment.rationale: No implementation-grade fix is selected until the configuration identity and reset boundary are confirmed.

issue_context.summary: The report says settings differ between non-elevated and elevated runs and may reset after restart or update; a fresh report was attached after the first triage pass.
known_information: The user gives a repeatable privilege-switch sequence involving Settings, FancyZones, Keyboard Manager, and PowerToys Run.
The issue says admin and non-admin runs use different configuration files.
A fresh diagnostic ZIP was attached in a follow-up comment.
Open #47238 concerns administrator startup behavior, but is not the same settings-synchronization report.
inferences: Separate per-user/elevation configuration locations are plausible, but the public report does not identify the exact paths or which module writes last.
The restart/update reset may be a second symptom of the same identity/path split or a separate migration issue.
issue_context.analysis: The report justifies targeted evidence collection before a design: identify the actual config paths and file timestamps under both tokens, then separate privilege switching from update migration.
initial_investigation: The issue is not a duplicate of #47238 based on current titles: #47238 focuses on always-start-as-admin, while #50371 focuses on settings divergence.
Current PowerToys elevation code and Settings module paths should be inspected together during implementation.
The diagnostic attachment is newer than the original automated triage comment.

information_gaps.information: The exact settings file paths and module/file timestamps observed in non-elevated versus elevated runs.
information_gaps.why_needed: Determines whether the root cause is per-user path separation, permissions, or update migration.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Capture both runs with `/bugreport` after changing one distinctive setting in each mode; include the affected module and whether the files differ by path or contents.

actions.label: Request elevated/non-elevated config paths
actions.note: Ask for evidence that separates path identity from update migration.

comment.body: The report already provides a useful sequence across non-admin and administrator launches and confirms that settings differ or reset; the follow-up also adds a fresh PowerToys report. To identify the fix boundary, please change one distinctive setting (for example a Keyboard Manager shortcut) in non-elevated mode, then capture the effective settings path and file timestamp in both modes and submit `/bugreport` immediately after switching back. Please also state whether the reset occurs only after an update or already after a same-version restart. This distinguishes per-user/config-path separation from migration or permission failure.
